sql: select e.key, e.state, v.version, v.frozen_at is not null as frozen, (select count(*) from experiment_arms a where a.version_id=v.id) as arms, (select count(*) from experiment_gates g where g.version_id=v.id) as gates from experiments e join experiment_versions v on v.experiment_id=e.id where e.key='mmsell-correlation-cap'
